decisive_items: paroxysmal palpitations on the day of chemotherapy treatment
Revealed sinus tachycardia and marked sinus arrhythmia
Showed frequent atrial premature beats and short-array chamber tachycardia
response.rationale: The acute palpitations and arrhythmias occurring on the day of chemotherapy, with no prior cardiac or metabolic disease and normal cardiac enzymes, most directly support chemotherapy-induced cardiotoxicity. Other candidates are either broader, descriptive, or rely on unsupported specificity.

rejected.why: Broad cardiomyopathy label; less temporally specific to the chemotherapy exposure.
Contradicted by no history of mental illness and by objective ECG/echo abnormalities.
Only underweight BMI is present; no nutritional deficiency features or supporting labs.
Valvular changes are present but do not explain the acute chemotherapy-day palpitations and arrhythmias.
Describes the arrhythmia itself rather than the underlying chemotherapy-related cause.
Over-specifies anthracycline cardiotoxicity when no anthracycline agent is mentioned.
Combines unsupported nutritional deficiency with cardiomyopathy; lacks deficiency evidence.
Takotsubo requires characteristic wall-motion/ballooning and often troponin changes, which are not described.
